Ayesha (CS): Quick sync — Stratus dedicated bring-up: quota request approved for 12 GPUs, customer wants 95th-pct latency < 120ms for chat endpoints. Planning a staged load test and autoscale thresholds. Who can own timing and runbooks?
Ravi (Infra): I can own the infra side. Suggest start smoke -> ramp -> soak over 3 windows. Proposed schedule: smoke 2pm UTC, ramp 4pm UTC, soak 6pm UTC on Thu. Will pre-provision reserved pool and set scaling cooldowns.
Tom (SRE): I’ll take monitoring & alerting. Need clear SLOs, error budgets, and rollback playbook. Can we use the existing runbook: `docs/runbooks/dedicated-capacity.md` as baseline?
Lena (PE): I’ll own the customer enablement checklist and run the validation prompts during soak. Will collect acceptance criteria from Stratus PM — they want a soft failback to hosted API if tails exceed 250ms.
Ayesha (CS): Sounds good. Two quick asks: 1) confirm quota priming script + warm cache plan, 2) confirm autoscale policy values so CS can communicate to PM.
Ravi (Infra): Quota priming: we'll run prefix-cache warmers and a KV prefill for 24h before tests. Priming script: `./tools/prime_pool.sh --pool stratus --duration 24h`. For autoscale: start at min=6 GPUs, max=18 GPUs, scale step=2, cooldown=120s. Target util breakpoints: 60% add, 30% remove.
Tom (SRE): Alert rules I'll configure: 
- `dedicated_pool_cpu_util > 90%` for 3m -> Sev2
- `p99_latency_chat > 180ms` for 5m -> Pager
- `error_rate > 0.5%` for 3m -> Oncall notify
I’ll add an ephemeral grafana dashboard link when ready.
deploy-bot: Load test schedule published to #release-war-room: Thu 14:00 UTC smoke, 16:00 ramp, 18:00 soak. CI job created: `ci/load-tests/stratus-dedicated`
Lena (PE): Acceptance checklist items: sample prompts (10k tokens mix), end-to-end auth check, KMS key verify, telemetry sampling. I’ll post the prompt pack to the customer and collect sign-off by Wed EOD.
Ayesha (CS): Risk callout: customer renewal in 5 weeks. If soak fails and we need a rollback, that impacts their SLA commitment. Keep exec-updates concise.
Ravi (Infra): Noted on rollback. Fallback plan: automated traffic-shift to hosted variant + throttling policy. Playbook snippet we’ll use:
```
# traffic-shift simple
api call: /v1/routing/shift
payload: {"route":"hosted-variant","percent":100}
```
Tom (SRE): Can someone confirm we have capacity headroom in staging sim to reproduce failure modes? If not, I'll block the ramp.
Ravi (Infra): Staging has 4 spare GPUs but not full replication. We’ll do a partial failure rehearsal there and use canary in prod pool for the soak.
Ayesha (CS): Action items: 
- Ravi: provision pool + priming script (owner)
- Tom: alerting + dashboard + runbook link (owner)
- Lena: prompt pack + customer sign-off (owner)
- Ayesha: exec note + renewal risk note (owner)
Please confirm by EOD and drop links to runbooks/tooling here. :thumbsup:
Tom (SRE): Confirmed — will post runbook link and dashboard by EOD.
Ravi (Infra): Confirmed — provisioning and priming scheduled, will paste logs when priming starts.
Lena (PE): Confirmed — prompt pack to customer today.
Ayesha (CS): Thanks team — marking this thread for follow-up and handoff to oncall before ramp.
